title: Three Children on Boulders in Woods, 1935 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid outdoor snapshot from August 1935 showing three siblings posing on large rocks in a sun-dappled wooded area. An older youth sits on a boulder holding a cheerful baby in his lap, while a barefoot child in workwear denim overalls with a wide white collar stands casually beside them with hands tucked into pockets. The informal attire and rugged forest setting capture an intimate, resilient moment of rural American childhood during the Great Depression.
